Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music | National ShattaFest 2026: Shatta Wale delivers memorable birthday celebration at Accra Sports Stadium Source : Myjoyonline.com 18 October 2026 6:05pm Audio By Carbonatix
Ghanaian dancehall star Shatta Wale has turned his 45th birthday celebration into a vibrant showcase of music, fan loyalty and entertainment, as ShattaFest 2026 drew thousands of fans and several prominent personalities to the Accra Sports Stadium.
Held on Saturday, October 17, the concert brought together members of the Shatta Movement and music lovers for a night of live performances, dancing and celebration, with the all-white dress code adding to the atmosphere.
The event featured performances from Medikal, Patapaa, Fancy Gadam, Jupitar, Kwesi Amewuga and Sista Afia, who each brought their individual styles to the stage.
Patapaa was among the early performers to excite the crowd, delivering his hit song One Corner before following up with Body Fi Body, his collaboration with Shatta Wale.
Accra came out for One Man, his name is @shattawalegh #shattawale #shattafest #MoMoFest #fyp #DoMoreWithMoMo https://t.co/hX6h7XINdR
Sista Afia also joined the headline act for a performance of their song Jeje, while Medikal’s appearance added another highlight as the pair performed their collaboration Sika.
Medikal rocking the stage at ShattaFest. #ShattaFestGh26 #ShattaFestAccra https://t.co/nKhu9B6qBH
One of the night’s most emotional moments came when Shatta Wale appeared overwhelmed by the turnout and the support from fans, breaking down in tears as he looked out at the crowd. The moment reflected the connection between the musician and his supporters, whose chants and participation have become a defining feature of his concerts.
The celebration also attracted notable personalities from entertainment, sports and public service. Actress Nana Ama McBrown made a surprise appearance, while Criminal Investigations Department Director-General COP Lydia Yaako Donkor, Black Stars goalkeeper Benjamin Asare and former footballer Prince Tagoe were among those spotted at the stadium.
This fan can’t hide his excitement as he sings along word for word to Shatta Wale’s songs at ShattaFest 2026. The energy at the Accra Sports Stadium is unmatched as fans celebrate the dancehall king in grand style! #ShattaFestAccra26 https://t.co/dyv2vUpx7s
Many other industry players have shared congratulatory messages after the event, acknowledging Shatta Wale’s influence in Ghana’s creative industry and among young people.
The gesture added a public dimension to a celebration largely centred on music and the artiste’s relationship with his fans.
Shatta Wale makes a grand entry onto the stage at ShattaFest 2026, sending the crowd into a frenzy as the King of African Dancehall takes center stage. The energy at the Accra Sports Stadium is absolutely unmatched. https://t.co/pNDd0AUV7d
Beyond the performances, ShattaFest offered another demonstration of the drawing power of Ghanaian popular music and the ability of artistes to mobilise large audiences around live entertainment.
Update: Current scene at the Shatta fest 2026 Full house energy https://t.co/5Tmt7ufO75
For Shatta Wale and his supporters, the night was more than a birthday concert. It was an opportunity to celebrate his musical journey, recognise the loyalty of the Shatta Movement and bring together performers and fans in a shared experience.
With a diverse line-up, celebrity appearances and an emotional moment from the headline act, ShattaFest 2026 ended as a memorable celebration of one of Ghana’s most prominent dancehall artistes.
